subject: Post-call recap — model shortlist, performance evidence, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@orionht.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — model shortlist, performance evidence, and next steps

Hi Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and what I promised we'd share: 

Summary of recommended model slate (based on the use cases you described: summarization for discharge notes, triage classification, and short-context Q&A):
- Llama-2-13B-chat (quantized FP16) — best balance of quality / unit cost for conversational summarization.
- Mistral-7B-Temporal — strong for short-context Q&A and faster p50 latency at lower batch sizes.
- RedGlass-6B (fine-tuned candidate) — highest precision for classification tasks in our test prompts; will need a small pilot to verify recall.

Redwood-verified performance snapshots (end-to-end inference):
- Llama-2-13B-chat: throughput 12 TPS (batch=8 typical), p50 85ms, p90 240ms, p99 620ms
- Mistral-7B-Temporal: throughput 22 TPS (batch=8), p50 42ms, p90 120ms, p99 300ms
- RedGlass-6B: throughput 28 TPS (batch=16), p50 35ms, p90 95ms, p99 260ms

Links & artifacts attached:
- orion_eval_promptpack_v1.json — canonical prompt set (what we used for the short qualification run).
- rwd_perf_profiles_snapshot.csv — raw per-request latencies and TPS traces for the above models.
- Redwood proof page: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/perf-profiles/20261115/orion-proof.html

Quality/regression notes:
- We observed occasional classification drift on RedGlass-6B when prompts included non-clinical abbreviations; recommend a 2000-sample guardrail set to run pre/post deploy.
- For summarization, keep max_context to 1024 tokens and use prefix KV cache to reduce cold-start p99 — we included a short trace showing cold vs warmed cache latencies in the CSV.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
1) 2-week pilot (recommended) — 50k tokens/day workload, Redwood Dedicated -> estimate below if you'd like capacity pricing.
2) Short follow-up technical call to walk through the prompt pack and pick the 3 canonical prompts for regression monitoring.

If you confirm option (1) we'll send: MAP v1, pilot SOW draft, and a small test dataset ingestion form.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min slot tomorrow if that helps.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: orion_eval_promptpack_v1.json (application/json), rwd_perf_profiles_snapshot.csv (text/csv)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the perf numbers — that helps a lot. A couple quick clarifications: 
1) For the p99 numbers, can you clarify whether those are cold-start included? We care about peak SLA for triage classification.
2) Would you be able to extract a 100-sample prompt subset from the prompt pack focusing only on real-world triage examples (we can anonymize) so our clinical reviewers can sanity-check outputs before a pilot?

If those look reasonable we will likely go the 2-week pilot route. Can you also paste a rough ballpark for Dedicated capacity monthly cost?

Best,
Alex

Hi Alex —

Quick answers:
- p99 numbers above include cold-start samples; the CSV separates warmed vs cold traces. For a production SLA we recommend warming policy + slight capacity buffer (we typically set a 10% warmed buffer for triage workloads). With warming, p99 for Mistral-7B sits closer to ~220–260ms.

- I'll pull the 100-sample subset from the prompt pack and scrub PHI (we'll replace with representative tokens) and upload to the Drive link by EOD.

Ballpark Dedicated capacity (monthly) for the pilot footprint you described (~50k tokens/day sustained with 10% burst):
- Baseline: $12k/month (shared reserved pool, non-SLA)
- Dedicated + 99.9% availability target: $28k/month (includes warm-cache policy and an ops runbook)

I've attached throughput-traces-20261117.tar.gz with per-region traces and a small p99 heatmap. Also linking the HubSpot deal if you want to attach the MAP: https://hubspot.com/deals/ORD-8721

If you're comfortable, I'll draft the MAP and send it to Marissa to align on milestones / acceptance criteria.
